en.name: Breast Lift (Mastopexy)
en.meta_title: Breast Lift (Mastopexy): Surgical Correction for Sagging Breasts
en.meta_description: Restore a youthful, firmer breast profile with a breast lift, or mastopexy. This procedure corrects sagging by raising the breasts, removing excess skin, and reshaping tissue for a perkier, more confident silhouette.
en.meta_keywords: breast lift, mastopexy, sagging breasts, ptosis correction, breast reshaping, breast lift with implants, cosmetic surgery, plastic surgery

what_is.heading: What is a Breast Lift? Restoring a Youthful Contour
paragraphs: A breast lift, or mastopexy, is a surgical procedure designed to restore a youthful, perkier breast profile by correcting sagging and improving shape. The effects of gravity, pregnancy, weight fluctuations, and aging can cause breasts to lose their firmness and droop. A breast lift raises the breasts to a higher position on the chest, creating a firmer, more youthful contour.

procedure.heading: The Mastopexy Procedure
paragraphs: During the procedure, our surgeons remove excess skin and skillfully reshape the internal breast tissue to create a more elevated and shapely breast mound. The nipple and areola are also repositioned higher on the breast. If volume loss is also a concern, a breast lift can be combined with implants (an augmentation-mastopexy) to restore both lift and fullness.

candidates_recovery.heading: Ideal Candidates and Recovery
paragraphs: Ideal candidates are women who are happy with their breast size but wish to correct sagging. The procedure is highly personalized, with incision patterns chosen to best address the degree of sagging and achieve the desired aesthetic outcome. Recovery involves about one to two weeks of downtime. The results of a breast lift are long-lasting, providing a more youthful and confident silhouette for years to come.
